# UI Vault — full catalog

> 814 entries from 15 sources. Generated by `npm run llms`.

## Sources

### React Bits — https://reactbits.dev
134 free MIT components across text animations, backgrounds, animations and interactive components, with TypeScript/JavaScript and Tailwind/CSS variants per component. Pro tier adds blocks and templates.
License: MIT. Install: npx jsrepo add react-bits/<Component>.
### Motion Primitives — https://motion-primitives.com
~35 minimalist motion components by ibelick, built entirely on Motion (motion.dev). Every component is a copy-paste primitive with a dedicated CLI. Pro adds 50+ premium components and sections.
License: MIT. Install: npx motion-primitives@latest add <name>.
### FancyComponents — https://fancycomponents.dev
~46 fun and weird components recreating effects from award-winning sites — letter swaps, gravity, elastic lines, gooey filters. Fully MIT and open source by danielpetho.
License: MIT. Install: pnpm dlx shadcn add @fancy/<component>.
### NumberFlow — https://number-flow.barvian.me
The animated number (odometer/digit-spin) component. Dependency-free custom element + Web Animations API, reduced-motion aware, SSR friendly. 7.7k GitHub stars.
License: MIT. Install: npm i @number-flow/react.
### Watermelon UI — https://watermelon.sh
Fully open-source shadcn-style library: components, animated micro-interactions, section blocks and 10+ complete dashboards. Free forever for personal and commercial use.
License: Free. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://registry.watermelon.sh/r/<name>.json.
### Aceternity UI — https://ui.aceternity.com
200+ production-ready components and blocks that "look expensive" — parallax heroes, beams, shaders, docks. Free tier covers ~100 components; premium adds 200+ blocks and full templates.
License: Freemium. Install: npx aceternity-ui@latest add <name>.
### shadcn/ui — https://ui.shadcn.com
65 Radix-based primitives — every install vendors the source into your project. Charts via Recharts, tables via TanStack, drawer via Vaul, carousel via Embla. The de-facto foundation most libraries below build on.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add <component>.
### Magic UI — https://magicui.design
76 animated components — animated beams, globes, marquees, device mocks, 18 text animations and 11 backgrounds. Distributed as a shadcn registry; templates are paid, all components are free.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/<component>.
### Animata — https://animata.design
154 published motion components across text, widgets, cards, bento grids, buttons and heroes — every one installable through a shadcn-style registry. The repo documents 198; 44 are still unpublished.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://animata.design/r/<name>.json.
### Animate UI — https://animate-ui.com
154 animated components in your choice of headless flavor — Radix UI, Base UI, Headless UI or native — plus 11 text animations and 14 effect primitives. All Motion-powered, installed via shadcn registry.
License: Free. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @animate-ui/<slug>.
### Launch UI — https://www.launchuicomponents.com
Free section library for marketing pages — navbar, hero, items, logos, FAQ, CTA, pricing, stats and footer blocks, plus button, badge, mockup, screenshot, glow, fade and glass utilities. React 19, Tailwind v4, Radix.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @launchui/<block>.
### Origin UI — https://coss.com/origin
The Origin UI legacy snapshot, preserved MIT inside the COSS monorepo after the rebrand: 599 variants across 31 families. Inputs alone ship 59 variants; buttons 54; selects 51.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://coss.com/origin/r/<family>.json.
### COSS UI — https://coss.com/ui
55 Base-UI-powered components, 2 hooks and 508 registry particles grouped into 54 families — the current-generation component collection from the COSS team, installed through the official @coss shadcn namespace.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @coss/<component>.
### Cult UI — https://cult-ui.com
77 MIT components — dithered and liquid-metal heroes, neumorphic and beam buttons, dynamic islands, macOS docks, 3D carousels, WebGL shaders and pixel typography. Cult Pro is a separate paid product; only the MIT repo set is cataloged.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://cult-ui.com/r/<name>.json.
### Kibo UI — https://www.kibo-ui.com
40 niche components no other library ships — Gantt charts, kanban boards, contribution graphs, credit cards, story reels, glimpse link previews, relative-time and Tinder-style decks. Fully client-side, no external services.
License: MIT. Install: npx kibo-ui add <component>.
